about: A forecast follows from evidence only under the assumptions and horizon it states: stated as a certainty it does not follow.

findings.title: Market outlook
findings.content: Our base case assumes demand grows 8% a year through 2030; under that assumption we project the widget price at $120 per unit in 2030, with a range of $90 to $150.

claims.claim: The outlook projects the widget price at $120 per unit in 2030, with a range of $90 to $150, assuming demand grows 8% a year through 2030.

conclusions.statement: The widget price will be $120 per unit in 2030.
If demand grows 8% a year through 2030, one outlook projects about $120 per unit in 2030, within $90 to $150.
